terrain_type: Coastal desert and inland desert (Cyrenaica-Marmarica-Western Desert). Gazala Line defensive positions April-May: fortified boxes in open desert with extensive minefields. Bir Hakeim sector (southern flank): rocky desert with some wadis. June pursuit operations: open desert ideal for mobile warfare. Via Balbia coastal road critical supply artery. El Alamein defensive line (end June): coastal plain narrowed by Qattara Depression 65 km south.
